cards.title: New pricing page with two plans
summary: Fieldnote now has a pricing page. It shows two plans. Starter is free for teams of up to five people. Team costs $12 per person each month and has no limits.

Under the plans is a short list of four questions people usually ask: changing plans, student pricing, what happens to notes if you cancel, and invoices. On a phone the two plan cards stack on top of each other.
cards.look: The two plan cards in the first picture, and the questions in the second.
flags: The buttons look right but do not go anywhere yet. Checkout was out of scope.
The student pricing answer is a guess. The brief did not say what the company offers.

cards.title: Sign-ups chart in the weekly report
summary: The weekly report now opens with a chart of sign-ups per day, with the number on top of each bar. Thursday is highlighted because it was the best day.
The numbers come from the same export as last Monday's report, so the two agree.
steps: Open the weekly report on a small phone.
Check that the Sunday bar is not cut off at the right edge.

cards.title: One shared date helper instead of three
summary: Three copies of the code that works out when a week starts had drifted apart, which is why two reports disagreed about the same week. They are now one shared helper, with 14 tests. All 14 pass.
Weeks now start on Monday everywhere. One old copy started on Sunday, so a report that used it may now show different numbers for the same dates.
cards.look: Nothing changes on screen. The notes file lists exactly what moved.

cards.title: Dark mode and email settings
summary: Settings now has two groups. Appearance holds a dark mode switch and a large text switch. Notifications holds the weekly summary email and mentions.
The switches move but are not saved yet. Saving them needs a decision about where settings live.
cards.ask: Should the weekly summary email start on or off for new people? I chose on.

demo.caption: The new settings page. The switches work, but nothing is saved yet.
